item.title: Treasuries’ Link to AI Shows Sharp Shift as Haven Trade Returns
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: A gauge of the inverse relationship between US government bonds and AI-focused stocks has strengthened to levels last seen a year ago. It’s a sign the deepening tech selloff is sending investors back into bonds for safety, reviving a haven role that had faded as inflation worries and higher interest rates weighed on Treasuries.
